# Buy Land in Peru

> On-the-ground guidance for people outside Peru who want to buy property there, from a small lot to large forest land. English and Spanish. Not a law firm, not a guaranteed investment, and buying does not grant residency.

Buy Land in Peru is a personal guide for buyers who do not live in Peru. The work covers what you actually want, where people live, how property is found, walking a place on the ground, due diligence, money and closing costs, and what happens after a purchase. Fees are quoted after a real intake. The guide is not your lawyer, notary, or accountant. Property values can fall.

- Contact: info@buylandinperu.com
- Book a meeting: https://calendar.app.google/h65oLNrYFP7pGCRKA
